name: Design variations
blurb: Plan N design variations of a brief, have HR Steel design each one, read the metrics out of the packages, apply an eligibility rule and a score, rank them and record your selection for the other modules.

tabs.title: Variations
tabs.blurb: Base brief → variation list (pick categories, describe the study, or let the model decide) → HR Steel designs each one → eligibility + score → sortable results → record your selection. Everything is saved in this project's folder under variations/.
